content.caseIdentity: ADM Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla, (1976) 2 SCC 521
content.holding: Held that during emergency no person had locus standi to move writ of habeas corpus. (Formally overruled by 44th Amendment and Puttaswamy).
content.relevance: The darkest hour of Indian jurisprudence, corrected by constitutional amendment.
